title: keel project config
description: Per-project config (project.yaml) for a keel thin-consumer: VALUES (knobs) plus add-only EXTENSIONS snapped into named backbone slots.

extends.description: Marker: this project consumes the keel backbone.

core_version.description: Pinned keel core version range, e.g. ^0.1.

base_branch.description: Branch PRs target, e.g. develop or main.

platform.description: Free-form platform tag, e.g. android-web, flutter-supabase, python.

timezone.description: IANA tz used for the merge window, e.g. Europe/Istanbul or Etc/GMT-3.

merge_window.description: Open merge window HH:MM-HH:MM (the complement is the night no-merge window).

merge_window_mode.description: Outside the window: 'freeze' blocks the merge but keeps gates/CI running (default); 'pause' halts the pipeline entirely.

ci_workflows.description: CI workflow display name -> path glob that gates it.

required_capabilities.description: Runtime capabilities that must be available before mutating work starts.

optional_capabilities.description: Runtime capabilities that may degrade when unavailable.

gates.description: Quality gates that run in the test step (built-in or extension-provided).

extensions.description: Add-only Lego pieces, keyed by named backbone slot.
